conventions.clipKeys: decoded from m_MuscleClip.m_Clip.data streamed words; key.time is seconds from clip start, rawTime is the serialized time (-FLT_MAX sentinel clamps to startTime), spriteIndex addresses pptrCurveMapping
conventions.framePng: byte-exact AssetStudio export of the sprite's trimmed textureRect; place it at textureRectOffset inside sprite.rect (y up), then anchor at sprite.pivot
conventions.lengthUnit: Unity units; sprite pixels convert via sprite.pixelsToUnits
conventions.pathIds: all Unity path ids are decimal strings (64-bit safe for JSON consumers)
conventions.spriteRect: pixel rect inside the source texture, origin at texture bottom-left, y up
conventions.transform: localPosition/localRotation/localScale are parent-relative, exactly as serialized
